title: Everyone is talking data centres. The numbers aren't showing it yet.

read: Data-centre demand is real for a few suppliers, but as a theme it is crowded: mentioning it on a call has not yet meant faster growth than peers.
sources: Vantage theme tracker and Q2 FY27 results filed on BSE, as of 18 Nov 2026
notes: A call counts when management discusses data-centre power, cooling, cables or electrical equipment demand. The comparison uses capital goods companies whose Q2 FY27 calls Vantage read, split by whether the call discussed the theme. Mentions say nothing about how big data centres are in each company's revenue.
